note: Each entry is a decision, not a measurement. `lines` is the ceiling that file may not exceed; `context`, `trackedBy` and `reason` say who holds the decision to keep it and why. `trackedBy` is the issue holding the decision, which is not always the issue that owns the decomposition, and not every entry has a decomposition owner at all - that is the intended steady state, since an entry is written when a decision names a file, not because a scan found it. Run `npm run file-size:report` to render this as the #778 index table, so the table is generated rather than retyped. See ADR-0044 and #1433.

apps/messenger-bot/src/modules/messenger.reason: No duplication finding. Raised by #1450 from 973 to 981: the concrete Redis-backed `RedisUserDisplayNameCache` injection became a port token, which costs the import, the `@Inject()` and a short note on why the parameter carries no `@Optional()`. Eight lines of wiring, no new behaviour. Raised again by #1420 from 981 to 988: a rate-limited send returns through `onRateLimited` and never reaches `onError`, so the staged-reschedule cleanup the error path already performs had to be called there too — one call plus a three-line note on why that hook is not redundant. #1084 touches one optional-method cast and does not decompose it.

packages/bot-metrics/src/bot-metrics.ser.reason: Largest candidate. No decomposition owner. Unlike the other four it has no extracted sibling to build a seam on. Raised by 1ff87bb5 from 1412 to 1456: `BotMetricsService` now implements `WebhookInboundMetricsPort`, which adds one import, three private field declarations, three metric registrations and three thin increment methods. That is the file's whole shape — it is a registry of counters and the increment methods that raise them — so the growth is the work and cannot be hoisted without inventing a second metrics class that the one seam this file lacks would have to be extracted into first. No duplication finding and no new behaviour: the counters observe a retention cron and the inline dispatch path that already existed.

packages/chat-agent/src/agent/platform-a.reason: Decomposed by #1143: the ~290-line clarification handler moved to `clarification/` (pure core, responder, text parser) and the service keeps only a delegating facade over it. 1187 -> 939 lines. The split left the repository slightly larger, so by ADR-0044 it bought nothing on its own; it was made because a field-access prohibition is only enforceable once the code that read the fields lives somewhere the type system can constrain. What is left is chat orchestration, and no duplication finding is recorded against it. Raised by #1420 from 939 to 972: a staged reschedule is released on every terminal path of the turn that staged it, which is one private helper plus a call at each of the five failure exits the method already had. The exits are spread across three catch blocks, so this cannot be collapsed into a single site without reshaping the reply contract.

packages/chat-agent/src/chat-queue/redis.reason: No duplication finding. Do not start before #774 retires the Messenger mirror spec; splitting now spends the spec work twice.

packages/chat-agent/src/clarification/cl.reason: Extraction destination, entered against ADR-0044's blanket rule that a new file is never gated. The rule was written when a new file was incidental - a helper, a spec - and it does not contemplate a new file that is the largest single file in its area. Nothing here proposes decomposing it: the thirteen terminal decision rules and the thirteen-key outcome table are one table and cannot be split without re-introducing the half-applied counted-but-not-sent pairing the table exists to prevent. It is the only new file from #1143 entered here; the state, core and text modules are 376, 311 and 232 lines by the checker's own raw count, and no decision names them. ADR-0044 records that raw and non-blank counts differ here, so measure with the checker rather than by eye.

packages/chat-metering/src/chat-rate-lim.reason: Owned by #1080, which names itself the concrete plan for this file. Most duplicated candidate, not the largest.

packages/llm-agent/src/agent.service.ts.reason: Split once already by #438. Extracted collaborators total 1196 lines, so the split left the repository 69 lines larger, not 59% smaller.
